create_run: create a run by calling start_run with body, thread_id, and FastAPI request to launch a background agent task
build_run_config: build a RunnableConfig dict from thread_id, request_config, metadata, and assistant_id with configurable context support
format_sse_frame: format a single SSE frame with event name, data payload, and optional event_id matching LangGraph Platform wire format
consume_sse_stream: consume SSE stream events from a StreamBridge and yield formatted frames with disconnect handling
normalize_input: normalize LangGraph Platform input format by converting dict messages to LangChain HumanMessage objects
